description: Opaque full-screen Gwanghwamun SD plaza with small baked-in Sejong, Admiral Yi and Haechi sculptures. All ground is traversable; centered uniform cover fitting preserves perspective.

stages.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: full-screen opaque 2D arena backdrop PNG for the Korean cute SD auto-combat game Seoul Hero.
Primary request: Completely NEW illustrated Gwanghwamun Square ground map, suited to a Galaxy S24 Ultra landscape 915:412 screen. This is a single finished background, including its tiny decorative landmark sculptures, not a tilesheet or an isometric diorama.
Composition/framing: very wide 20:9 / 915:412 landscape, ideally 1830 by 824 px. Orthographic slightly elevated top-down ground view, no horizon, no sky. Entire image from edge to edge is level walkable ground, cropped naturally at all four edges. There is no raised perimeter, wall or outside region. Major landmarks stay within the central 70 percent of width and central 65 percent of height, with generous open combat space around them.
Scene: bright modern Seoul civic plaza. Warm pale blue-grey and ivory pavement with many SMALL individual pavers, tasteful subtle variation, occasional broad thin civic-inlay arcs. Include an unmistakable soft blue-grey asphalt Seoul roadway crossing the lower half of the arena and branching gently on one side; sensible thin white dashed lane markings, two zebra crossings, and three clear white direction arrows. Ground pattern reads at small game-screen scale without busy noise. Paving stones must remain much smaller than a game character, not giant square tiles.
Landmark subjects: a small gold seated King Sejong statue with recognizable tall royal cap and an open book, a small bronze Admiral Yi Sun-sin statue standing upright with a helmet and ceremonial sword, and TWO cute stone Haechi / Haetae lion statues facing inward. Sculptures are tiny cute cartoon miniature monuments in the plaza interior, not people. Sejong and Yi should each occupy about 8 to 10 percent of image height, Haechi 5 to 6 percent. Low compact plinths, slight three-quarter volume, restrained contact and directional shadows tie them to the ground. Spread the four sculptures around the central plaza so none form an obstacle wall or border. Their contrast is gentler than foreground characters.
Style/medium: polished hand-painted mobile-game cartoon environment, cute and light, simple readable shapes and gently rounded geometry, clean fine navy-grey contour lines, flat two-tone cell shading with soft enamel-like lighting. Match SD/chibi game dolls. It must be an actual new artistic composition, not a recoloring of a old stone-tile photo.
Lighting/mood: cheerful clear daytime, gentle light from upper left, soft grounded short shadows, inviting and legible.
Color palette: pale airy ivory-blue stone, muted soft slate-blue roadway, warm golden statue highlights, tiny mint accents. Brighter than a grim military battlefield but keep the floor calm so foreground monsters and purple drops remain readable.
Constraints: all decoration is painted directly into this one flat background. There are no physical obstacles in gameplay; keep the entire scene visually traversable. No buildings, palace, Gwanghwamun gate structure, roofs, fences, perimeter decoration, stairs, cars, vehicles, pedestrians, living characters, monsters, UI, HUD, text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. No perspective horizon, no fish-eye view, no steep isometric board, no photorealism, no noisy gritty textures, no paper cutout aesthetic, no vignette. Full opaque background, no transparency.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: full-screen 20:9 Gwanghwamun ground arena backdrop for a cute SD game.
Edit target: the provided existing newly generated map image. Keep its exact wide aspect, orthographic elevated camera, clean bright cute cartoon art, paving sizes, road, lane markings, arrows, zebra crossings and ground inlay circles.
Make this one targeted refinement: reduce vertical decorative obstacles so this whole image reads as an open walkable floor.
1. Remove ALL trees, bushes, planted flowerbeds, tall flower boxes, small square planters and perimeter foliage from the entire image, filling their exact places with matching paving and ground inlay patterns. The entire border must be unobstructed paving/road, no framing objects or edge decoration.
2. Retain exactly four landmark sculptures in their current approximate interior locations: seated golden Sejong, standing bronze Admiral Yi, left Haechi and right Haechi. Shrink each COMPLETE sculpture including its plinth to roughly 55 percent of its current height. Their bases must be a low single shallow step, not the current tall blocks or multiple stairs. Fill the newly exposed area with continuous ground. Sejong and Yi including bases should be about 10 to 12 percent of the image height; Haechi including bases about 7 percent. Preserve recognizability of the royal cap/open book, admiral helmet/sword, and cute stone guardian-lion faces. Small soft contact shadows only, these must feel like tiny background ornaments with lots of walkable floor around them.
No other changes. Keep the beautiful soft slate-blue road and white markings, light ivory small-paver plaza, existing circular motifs, all ground proportions and calm readable daylight palette. No buildings, gates, roofs, new objects, cars, characters, text, UI, logos, watermark, horizon, dark vignette or texture noise. Opaque PNG, no transparency.
